title_en: Villa for sale in Lulebore Residence, TEG
description_en: The Lulebore residence was conceived with a modern project of villas organized on three floors. Strategic location among the greenery of the hills of Lundre with a view towards the west, very close to TEG, with direct access to the big ring road. Individual villa with 2 floors + a basement floor. Villas total area 323.9m2, plot area 395.9m2. The basement consists of: - 2 parking spaces - technical area - warehouse, laundry - living area, gym. The ground floor consists of: - distribution corridor - a toilet, studio, living room - kitchen + dining room. The first floor consists of: - double bedroom + wardrobe and toilet - 2 bedrooms - toilet and balcony - distribution corridor For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
